name: Taiwan Shin Kong Security Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Taipei City, Taiwan, in 1980, Taiwan Shin Kong Security Co., Ltd. delivers a broad spectrum of security solutions to clients both within Taiwan and across the globe. The company's core services include electronic security systems, secure cash logistics, and professional stationed guard services. They manage the entire lifecycle of protective infrastructure, from the conceptual design, sales, leasing, and installation to the ongoing maintenance, repair, and inspection of facilities engineered to resist natural calamities, theft, and fire. Additionally, they facilitate the import and export of related security products and actively invest in and operate relevant business endeavors. For individual homeowners, their provisions span home surveillance setups, secure storage options, comprehensive home and long-term care support, and vehicle security. Business clients benefit from specialized corporate security services covering factories, offices, entire building systems, fleet management, retail establishments, financial institutions, and hospital clinics. Their technological offerings further extend to advanced video surveillance devices, Webcams, smart green building integration, access control systems, fire safety measures, treasury management tools, automated deposit machines, and business assistant POS systems.
